name: Euro Trousers Customs & Warehouse Management System
description: Enterprise Customs & Warehouse Management System for EURO TROUSERS MFG. CO. (FZC), SAIF Zone, Sharjah, UAE. Featuring 12 customs modules, 10 RBAC roles, 4-tier declaration approval workflow, dual-ledger stock reconciliation, bilingual EN/AR RTL support, document generation with QR verification, and Tally/Sharjah ePortal integration.
